title: Panel Synthesis
description: VERIFY-stage gate-ish artifact. Output of review-synthesizer. Structured reconciliation of all panel_reviews and the critic_memo into a single verdict. check_synthesis_coverage.py refuses emission if any reviewer BLOCK is unaddressed or any critic block_flag is undocumented. Verdict APPROVE only when all blocks cleared; BLOCK otherwise.

verdict.description: APPROVE only when all reviewer BLOCKs are addressed and all critic block_flags documented; BLOCK otherwise

violations.description: list of coverage violations that caused BLOCK verdict; empty iff APPROVE

addressed_blocks.description: reviewer BLOCK findings and critic block_flags that have been explicitly rebutted or resolved

block_source.description: id or description of the original block (finding_id or flag_text)

rebuttal.description: explicit rebuttal argument; must cite evidence

unaddressed_blocks.description: reviewer BLOCK findings or critic block_flags present in panel but not rebutted; must be empty for APPROVE

open_critic_flags.description: critic block_flags not yet resolved; must be empty for APPROVE

overall_summary.description: optional prose summary of the synthesis (feeds synthesis-writer)
